name: Maria Okafor
title: Operations Manager
raw_text: BlueRidge HVAC & Plumbing is a family-owned service company serving the Denver metro area for 18 years. We are hiring three additional dispatchers and four HVAC technicians as we open service in two new counties this spring. Operations Manager Maria Okafor told the local business journal that scheduling still lives in a shared spreadsheet and that missed arrival windows were the top complaint in last year's customer survey. During the July heat wave our dispatchers worked overtime for six straight weeks.

name: Tom Brandt
title: Owner
raw_text: Brandt Electric is a residential and light-commercial electrical contractor in Austin, Texas with 22 employees. Jobs are written on paper tickets and the schedule is kept on a whiteboard in the shop. Owner Tom Brandt posted that he is happy with steady growth from Google reviews and referrals. The company has no open positions and no announced expansion plans.

name: Priya Nair
title: COO
raw_text: Sunline Solar Services announced a $12 million Series A to expand its maintenance fleet from 30 to 70 trucks across Arizona and Nevada. COO Priya Nair said routing and scheduling are the biggest operational bottleneck as the fleet doubles. The company's current field-service tool is on an older platform whose contract renews in March, and the team is evaluating alternatives this quarter.

name: Greg Hall
title: VP Marketing
raw_text: Pixel & Pine Studio is a 30-person brand and web design agency in Portland. name: Lena Vogel
title: Head of Dispatch
raw_text: Rapid Rooter Drain Services appointed Lena Vogel as Head of Dispatch last month, a newly created role. In her first interview she said technicians lose hours every day to windshield time because jobs are assigned by phone, and that overtime has risen sharply. The Tampa company operates 28 service vans and takes emergency calls around the clock.

name: Daniel Ruiz
title: Finance Manager
raw_text: Harborline Logistics processes roughly 4,000 vendor invoices every month, almost all keyed in by hand by a three-person accounts payable team. Finance Manager Daniel Ruiz said month-end close takes nine working days and that two duplicate payments were discovered last quarter. The company is hiring a fourth accounts payable clerk to keep up with volume.

name: Aisha Rahman
title: Controller
raw_text: Cedar & Co Accounting, a 45-person firm in Chicago, migrated to a new ERP system last quarter. Controller Aisha Rahman wrote in the firm newsletter that audit season starts in six weeks and that collecting and approving client invoices by email is the slowest part of the process. The firm plans to evaluate invoice automation tools after audit season.

name: Kevin Liu
title: CTO
raw_text: NovaChip Labs develops low-power chip architectures for edge devices. The 800-person company employs a large in-house engineering group and publishes research on memory design. CTO Kevin Liu keynoted a hardware conference last month. The company's finance operations run on an enterprise suite managed by a dedicated shared-services team.

name: Sofia Marin
title: Head of Finance
raw_text: GreenCrate Meal Kits closed a seed extension in the spring and is adding two fulfillment centers. Head of Finance Sofia Marin disclosed in a founder podcast that the company received a state sales-tax notice after missing supplier invoices during a rapid expansion, and that supplier invoices arrive across five different inboxes. The finance team has three people and no AP automation.
